title: Implement bwrk next single-directive command
description: WHY: bundles carry everything but agents act on one thing at a time; a single-directive command makes the CLI self-driving and trivially testable. WHAT: bwrk next [--agent <id>] [--json] resolves the acting agent state (active reservation via the existing agent status machinery at apps/cli/src/commands.ts buildAgentStatus, else claimable work, else workspace health), collects the current gaps for that subject, projects them through the registry, and returns exactly one directive - highest severity, then deterministic tie-break (stable sort by gap code then subject id, matching the codebase convention of localeCompare tie-breaks) - including the executable command and the why. When nothing applies, return an explicit idle result naming the state checked (no ready work, no reservation, all gates satisfied) rather than empty output. Register in the command registry with usage; text mode prints the command on the last line so shells can capture it. Depends on the sprint 3 projection being in place.
acceptanceCriteria: bwrk next --json returns exactly one directive with an executable command across fixture states for blocked, in-progress with open declared gate, unclaimed ready work and idle
Output is deterministic for identical state, covered by a repeat-invocation test
Command registered with usage text and JSON envelope consistent with existing commands
